attBesluta.text: The headstock design is clever, with a large through-hole that accommodates longer workpieces. That’s a feature not every small lathe includes, and it really opens up the range of projects I can take on.
Build quality is robust, and the machine feels well-assembled. There’s no play in the chuck, and the cross-slide moves smoothly without backlash. Very important for precision work.

For the price, this lathe is unbeatable in terms of features. The ability to handle both imperial and metric threads is a huge plus, and I’ve had no issues threading stainless or brass so far. Great value overall.
Ideal for prototyping and small repairs. I’ve used it on everything from copper plumbing parts to acrylic components, and it hasn’t let me down yet. Clean cuts and consistent performance every time.

Only used a couple of times but works very well compared to using the impact version. The hose that comes on it is too short because it makes it awkward to use. I will add a longer hose to make it easier to use. But for the price it will be a useful tool at reasonable price. It expanded a 3" exhaust pipe with ease. It was delivered with one latch broke but no big deal.
